paragraphs.text: 1. No peril, no severe distress, ye Gods, affects the mortal man,
paragraphs.original: न तमंहो न दुरितं देवासो अष्ट मर्त्यम् ।
paragraphs.translit: na tamaṃho na duritaṃ devāso aṣṭa martyam |

paragraphs.text: Whom Aryaman and Mitra lead, and Varima, of one accord, beyond his foes.
paragraphs.original: सजोषसो यमर्यमा मित्रो नयन्ति वरुणो अति द्विषः
paragraphs.translit: sajoṣaso yamaryamā mitro nayanti varuṇo ati dviṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. This very thing do we desire, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman,
Whereby ye guard the mortal man from sore distress, and lead him safe beyond his foes.
paragraphs.original: येना निरंहसो यूयं पाथ नेथा च मर्त्यमति द्विषः
paragraphs.translit: yenā niraṃhaso yūyaṃ pātha nethā ca martyamati dviṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. These are, each one, our present helps, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.
paragraphs.original: ते नूनं नोऽयमूतये वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
paragraphs.translit: te nūnaṃ no'yamūtaye varuṇo mitro aryamā |

paragraphs.text: Best leaders, best deliverers to lead us on and bear as safe beyond our foes.
paragraphs.original: नयिष्ठा उ नो नेषणि पर्षिष्ठा उ नः पर्षण्यति द्विषः
paragraphs.translit: nayiṣṭhā u no neṣaṇi parṣiṣṭhā u naḥ parṣaṇyati dviṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Ye compass round and guard each man, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman:
paragraphs.original: यूयं विश्वं परि पाथ वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
paragraphs.translit: yūyaṃ viśvaṃ pari pātha varuṇo mitro aryamā |

paragraphs.text: In your dear keeping may we be, ye who are excellent as guides beyond our foes.
paragraphs.original: युष्माकं शर्मणि प्रिये स्याम सुप्रणीतयोऽति द्विषः
paragraphs.translit: yuṣmākaṃ śarmaṇi priye syāma supraṇītayo'ti dviṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 5. Adityas are beyond all foes,-Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman:
paragraphs.original: आदित्यासो अति स्रिधो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
paragraphs.translit: ādityāso ati sridho varuṇo mitro aryamā |

paragraphs.text: Strong Rudra with the Marut host, Indra, Agni let us call for weal beyond our foes.
paragraphs.original: उग्रं मरुद्भी रुद्रं हुवेमेन्द्रमग्निं स्वस्तयेऽति द्विषः
paragraphs.translit: ugraṃ marudbhī rudraṃ huvemendramagniṃ svastaye'ti dviṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 6. These lead us safely over all, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman,
paragraphs.original: नेतार ऊ षु णस्तिरो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
paragraphs.translit: netāra ū ṣu ṇastiro varuṇo mitro aryamā |

paragraphs.text: These who are Kings of living men, over all troubles far away beyond our foes.
7. May they give bliss to aid us well, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman:
May the Adityas, when we pray, grant us wide shelter and defense beyond our foes.
paragraphs.original: शर्म यच्छन्तु सप्रथ आदित्यासो यदीमहे अति द्विषः
paragraphs.translit: śarma yacchantu sapratha ādityāso yadīmahe ati dviṣaḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. As in this place, O Holy Ones, ye Vasus freed even the Gaud when her feet were fettered.
paragraphs.original: यथा ह त्यद्वसवो गौर्यं चित्पदि षिताममुञ्चता यजत्राः ।
paragraphs.translit: yathā ha tyadvasavo gauryaṃ citpadi ṣitāmamuñcatā yajatrāḥ |

paragraphs.text: So free us now from trouble and affliction: and let our life be lengthened still, O Api.
paragraphs.original: एवो ष्वस्मन्मुञ्चता व्यंहः प्र तार्यग्ने प्रतरं न आयुः
paragraphs.translit: evo ṣvasmanmuñcatā vyaṃhaḥ pra tāryagne prataraṃ na āyuḥ
